last_summary: Replication Watch run 3 (gear 1, free deepseek-v4.1-flash; no credit fallback). +3 validations, rotating to the two rails that held ZERO: LENR sharpened and the biofield/bio-photonics rail opened. Yard now 28 quests / 32 dossiers / 15 validations. (1) LENR — A SELF-REPLICATION THAT WEAKENS ITS OWN CLAIM: Kasagi, Itoh, Shibasaki (Clean Planet) & Iwamura, JCMNS 41 (Jun 2026) 62-72, doi 10.70923/001c.163335 (arXiv:2509.13847) — photon-radiation calorimetry (total radiated energy measured directly, NOT fitted to a gray-body model) on NiCu composite films AND pure Ni foil at ~1100 K in vacuum: excess ~1.1 W NiCu, a slightly smaller excess in PURE Ni, sustained >=215 h, decay >2000 h, >22 keV/H, spectrum peaking ~0.2 eV and rising below 0.3 eV. The authors' own two stated differences from their 2025 report (JCMNS 39:210-219, 4-6 W) are (i) the NiCu excess is MUCH SMALLER than before and (ii) a clear excess now appears in plain Ni — i.e. the material-specificity dissolved; they also state excess energy alone cannot establish a nuclear origin. Medium confidence; sharpens Dossier 021's double-observable rule. (2) BIOFIELD, FIRST-CLASS NEGATIVE: Ilgeviciene et al., J. Complexity in Health Sciences, 15 Jun 2026, doi 10.21595/chs.2026.26701 — n=120 before/after holding rock crystal 10 min, then n=28 through baseline-placebo-crystal, read by Bio-Well/GDV: crystal moved the parameters significantly AND GLASS PRODUCED SIMILAR CHANGES (authors blame silica composition). The tradition's own control ate the crystal-specific claim; the live question is now whether Bio-Well/GDV is reproducible at all. (3) BIOFIELD, THE OTHER HALF: Smotrys/Gu/Poirier et al. (First Institute of All Medicines), NCT06855459 / FIAM-SC255, registered 2025-02-10, COMPLETED (primary completion 2026-04-30); results in J. Nanotechnology Research & Reports (SRC Publishers) doi 10.47363/jnrrr/2025(7)242 — 71 adults, 14 nights >=8 h with a commercial Tesla BioHealing Biophotonizer-A or visually identical placebo: ~2.7x CD34+, ~3.5x CD133+, ~3.1x CD34+CD133+ (all p<0.01), no placebo change, SF-36 +16-30%, PDI -7.35, no adverse events; preceded by an open-label pilot claiming a 336% CD34+ rise. CONFIDENCE LOW and it is the loud-flag class: the design POOLS the first 21 unblinded pilot participants into the treatment arm; sponsor not independent of the named commercial product; the paper appears under TWO different SRC journal titles, the publisher is unindexed in Scopus/WoS, and the article's own landing page, fetched for this record, was INJECTED WITH INDONESIAN GAMBLING SPAM (a hijacked/vanity-outlet signature); analysed N (71) exceeds the registered target (~46) with no explanation. Recorded single-source, unconfirmed. Contrast case logged as a watch item, not a result: UC Irvine NCT07581080, an independent pre-registered Reiki crossover pilot (n~12, EEG + blood biomarkers, start 2026-04-20). FLAG — THE DOSSIER COLLISION HAS HEALED: the published feed now carries 32 of 32 dossier files, including the three dropped since 09-17 (021-anomalous-heat-double-observable, 022-earth-energy-grid-instrument-scan, 026-water-dowsing-buried-targets); the '29 vs 32' gap reported 09-18/19/20 is closed at this revision. NOT resolved: the duplicate numbering itself (2x021, 2x022, 2x026 still on disk) and the unconfirmed dedupe mechanism — reported, not mutated. TORSION produced no qualifying new replication this run: the 2026 torsion literature surfaced is either mainstream torsion-balance gravimetry (arXiv:2608.26096; MDPI Symmetry 18:559), secondary commentary (Aug 2026 Kozyrev-mirror explainers), or a results-free construction manual (Percudani 'Puan Station 36+1', Zenodo 2026-04-24) — reported as a null sweep, not silently skipped. Feed rebuilt by the Yard-only merge (practical replaced from a builder run; library validations 12->15, replication_dossiers 29->32, generated_at refreshed): net diff 42 insertions / 3 deletions, seam 15.76 MB preserved, archive_entries 80,395, latest_finds 183 unchanged; the whole-feed builder path remains unsafe on this sandbox (it gutted translations to 135 works / 0 files against the absent master index before crashing on bake_stats). INCIDENT (live-site, fixed this run): the committed library_feed.json on main was INVALID JSON — the Translation-QC commit 16b3be9 had injected its own commit subject into the file twice, as ' (Translation-QC: fix mojibake in library_feed, add missing file ref)' appended to two "last_run" lines in the agents block — so the published feed would not parse for any consumer. That same commit also re-serialized the whole feed with ensure_ascii=True, inflating it 21,940,021 -> 23,069,175 B (+1.1 MB of \uXXXX escapes) against the builder's canonical json.dump(..., indent=2, ensure_ascii=False). This run stripped the two injected fragments, restored the canonical serialization, and merged practical on top; file is now 21,943,167 B and parses. Reported, not hidden: the format churn and the corrupted commit are named in navigator/ACTIVITY.md.
